name: 19347-beamsearch-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM dense decoder, 8B, bfloat16: 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, native window 131072.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1, bounded at 64 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, first 10% warmup and last 10% cooldown by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: prompt EXACTLY 4000 tokens and output EXACTLY 8, min = max on both. Sent non-streamed to `/v1/chat/completions` with `use_beam_search: true`, `n: 30` and `temperature: 0` in the body (`spec.backend.extras.body`); `n` IS the beam width, and `ignore_eos: true` keeps all 8 steps running. The chat template wraps the prompt, so the engine sees ~4012 tokens rather than 4000.
purpose: An 8B assistant drafting 30 alternative short completions per 4000-token document, one request at a time on a single GPU.
launch:
# A stock single-GPU serve of a bf16 8B chat model, driven with beam search over the
# OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint. Engine: commit 82b05b15e61badfd0c5912d4c3eebc88043c9ef8.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Forced, not chosen: a beam-search request at `n: 30` is refused by the v1 request processor
# against its default `max_logprobs` of 20, and every request then fails validation.
max-logprobs: 60

max-model-len: 8192

enable-prefix-caching: true
